answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on invitation quota tree, split across independent auditors, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Every claim climbs the opal of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the meadow re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
